name: clawpage
description: Generative UI hosting on clawpage.ai — publish single-file HTML pages, dashboards, and interactive apps from coding agents to a public URL.

interface.shortDescription: Generative UI hosting — publish HTML pages and dashboards to a public URL
interface.longDescription: Use Clawpage to convert any long, complex, or interactive response into a hosted page at a public clawpage.ai URL. Skills cover page create/update, reusable templates, per-user KV data, short links, blob storage, and view stats. The runtime is the @clawpage.ai/cli npm package — installed on demand via npx, no global install needed.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into a clawpage page I can share.
Create a dashboard for this data on clawpage.
